channel.title: SnowScope · Snow reports
channel.description: Daily snow reports for skiers: where the snow is, what is coming and where to ski, from the SnowScope snow map and measuring stations. Every number comes from that day's data.

item.title: Early-season snow check, 3 November: Western Canada and the US West lead
item.description: Snow on 3 November 2026: Kendall Mountain 134 cm after a storm, Big White 91 cm, the Alps up to 55 cm at Bonneval-sur-Arc. Model and station data.
